title: Professional Profile
description: Senior Guidewire specialist with 4+ years in the insurance industry, including a year and a half as a solutions architect. End-to-end experience across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter: product modeling with APD, configuration (PCF, business rules and rating), event-driven integrations and Java/Spring Boot microservices on Azure. Led squads technically and sat on the architecture committee for the migration of an insurance core system, with a focus on quality, security and observability. An accounting background gives me a deep understanding of the policy's financial lifecycle. Intermediate English (B1) and basic Portuguese.
name: Carmen Salinas Zavala
job1Items: Configuration and development in PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter with Gosu and Java: PCF, business rules, typelists and extensions.
Event-driven integrations using events, message queues and asynchronous processing, including external providers for vehicle claims (Audatex) and documents (Danna Connect).
Spring Boot microservices for JSON–XML transformation, containerized with Docker.
Batch processes and bulk loads with Workload and DataStage; queries and data fixes on Oracle and SQL Server.
Resolved production incidents through log analysis, tracing and queue cleanup.
job2Items: Integrated the accounting system with the logistics system using JavaScript.
REST APIs in Node.js for MongoDB, SQL database maintenance and automated tests with Selenium.
Deployed the website on Google Cloud Platform.
